title: Payoff Memo: Hearthstone Home Finance Payoff Figure in an In-Place Home Resale Price
content:
**Payoff figure.** In the lowest closing price of an In-Place Home Resale listing, the Hearthstone Home Finance amount among the closing deductions is the Hearthstone payoff figure, chosen in this order: for an open (active or delinquent) Hearthstone Home Finance loan on the home, a payoff statement on that loan whose good-through date is the handling date or later supplies its payoff amount; failing such a statement, the open loan is projected as its unpaid principal plus fees owed on the loan less suspense funds plus interest at the note rate on the unpaid principal for the days of the closing horizon on an actual-over-365 basis, that interest and the projection each rounded half up to the cent; a home with no open Hearthstone loan takes the unpaid principal of its loan, which is zero once paid off, whatever payoff statement remains on file.

**Records read.** The Home Purchase Financing loan on the home and its status (an open loan is one in active or delinquent status); its unpaid principal, note rate, fees owed and suspense funds; and the latest payoff statement issued on it, with its good-through date and payoff amount.

| Home Purchase Financing loan on the home | Latest payoff statement good through the handling date or later | Payoff figure |
|---|---|---|
| open (active or delinquent) | yes | the statement's payoff amount |
| open (active or delinquent) | no (none, or its good-through date has passed) | projected: principal plus loan fees less suspense plus horizon interest |
| not open (paid off, or none) | yes or no: any statement remaining on file is not used | the loan's unpaid principal as it stands (zero once paid off) |

## Worked projection (hypothetical loan, closing horizon 35 days)

Unpaid principal 41250.00, note rate 8.25 percent, fees owed on the loan 35.00, suspense funds 120.00, no payoff statement good through the handling date.

- Interest: 41250.00 times 8.25 percent, divided by 365, times 35 days is 326.3356, rounded half up to 326.33.
- Projection: 41250.00 plus 35.00 less 120.00 plus 326.33 is **41491.33**.

Had a payoff statement on this open loan good through 30 June been on file with a handling date of 20 June, its payoff amount would have been used instead of the projection; with a handling date of 1 July that statement no longer qualifies. Had the loan been paid off, a statement still good through the handling date would not be used: the payoff figure would be the loan's unpaid principal, 0.00.
